blinding_limit: Procedural only; code author designed both source and candidate families.

S-05E2.description: Outcome is noisy XOR of v0 and context.
S-05E2.intended_contrast: A relation visible only when context participates.

S-11B3.description: Independent pseudorandom outcome and recorded variables.
S-11B3.intended_contrast: Search-generated apparent structure without a planted relation.

S-197C.description: Discovery outcome is a noisy copy of v2; confirmation outcome is independent.
S-197C.intended_contrast: Detectable sample-specific structure that should not generalize.

S-B4E5.description: Outcome is noisy XOR of v0, v1, and v2.
S-B4E5.intended_contrast: Higher-order relation with weak pairwise visibility.

S-D592.description: Outcome is a deterministic SHA-256-derived bit with hidden input state.
S-D592.intended_contrast: Determinism that may remain random-looking under available perspectives.
